basic_profile.bio: I'm a 24-year-old tech enthusiast from Austin, Texas, currently working as a junior IT support specialist. I'm new to Reddit but already finding it a great place to learn and share knowledge. I'm passionate about remote-controlled crawlers and dabbling in stock trading, especially penny stocks. I tend to browse Reddit during late evenings after work. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends exploring new tech and occasionally working on projects for micronations.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a bachelor's degree in Information Technology and have been working in the field for about a year. Most of my expertise comes from hands-on experience and self-learning through online courses and forums. I also have a keen interest in stock trading, which I started exploring a few months ago.
